The Marches of Calder

The dwarven hold of Kragmoor guards the eastern pass.
Thistledown, a halfling village, sits beside the brook.
Hunters still camp in the old elven ruins of Silverleaf.
The dwarven quarter of Port Vennick smells of coal smoke.
The Illuskan town of Harrowmere trades in furs.
Bramblegate, home to many halflings, keeps three mills.
Oakhollow is mostly humans.
Duskwater, populated mainly by gnomes, builds clocks for the whole valley.
Stonereach, a town of 2,000 dwarves, mines tin.
The tiefling city of Embervale never sleeps.
Greywatch is an orcish fortress.
Mosswick, an old gnomish town, has fallen quiet.

A dwarven smith of Kragford works the forge by the gate.
The Northern town of Wellby is quiet in winter.
Is Fenwick a halfling village?
If Rookhill were an elven town, the elves would return.
Lakeby is not mostly humans.
Cindermoor was mostly dwarves until the flood.
Dwarven ale is sold in Brindle.
After the battle at Harlow, many dwarves fled north.
Old Mother Gwen, a halfling, lives in Pebbleford.
Merchants say Crowmarsh is mostly orcs.
